findings: Cook§88 prints personal accusative hwone, with neuter hwæt. The provisional Hwan in one example and its corresponding private model was replaced by Hwone.
Cook§88 prints dative hwǣm with hwām in parentheses. The productive examples, dialogue and models use primary Hwǣm; Hwām remains a separately bounded reference variant in the grammar audit.

Cook§86 explicitly makes ilca weak and self strong and weak. Cook§87 separately recognizes bare inflected demonstrative relatives, demonstrative plus ðe, and invariant ðe. Ordinary production is bounded by the grammar audit, with case attraction treated separately.

Cook§89 includes indefinite ān as well as sum. Prior cardinal ān does not establish the additional a/certain sense; the design explicitly defers that sense with the remaining indefinite families to Unit15.
The exact merchant selection has four complete alternating turns. Its endpoint unēaðe cwic ætberstende closes the merchant's answer before the next commodity-list question.

The source editor's continuous Old English text agrees with the selected page images, including sęcge, āstīge, rōwe, cīepe, dēorwierðu, ācęnnede, tōgelǣde, forlidennesse and ætberstende. No additional spelling correction is requested.
Page129 dialogue line counts are editorial; page130 numbering is printed and anchored by5 at ic hit. Preserve that distinction in the contract and exports.
All15 attached notes are preserved as source paratext, including note129.5 continued on130. Their historical etymological question is not a new graded task or a course claim.
